projects.name: Tracky (Expense tracker)
projects.description:
Tracky is a modern personal expense and budget tracking application built to make financial tracking simple, clear, and easy to use.

Track your spending, keep your expenses organized, and get a better understanding of where your money goes — all through a clean and focused experience.

projects.name: SkyCast
projects.description:
SkyCast – Weather Forecast Web App  
A modern and responsive weather application that provides real-time weather information for any city. Users can search locations or use their current location to view temperature, hourly forecasts, air conditions, and a 5-day forecast, with support for °C/°F, dark mode, favorites, and search history.

projects.name: TaskFlow – Task Management App
projects.description:
TaskFlow – Task Management App

A modern and responsive task management application designed to help users organize and track their daily tasks efficiently. It includes task creation, priority management, due dates, search and filtering, completion tracking, and productivity statistics through a clean, user-friendly interface.

projects.name: NOVA – E-Commerce Website
projects.description:
NOVA – E-Commerce Website
  
A modern, responsive e-commerce storefront designed to deliver a realistic online shopping experience. It features product discovery, live search, filtering and sorting, product quick view, wishlist management, an animated cart drawer, multi-step checkout, order confirmation, dark mode, and persistent browser storage with smooth UI interactions.
